label: Figure 13.1: The circular flow of income (referenced diagram)
alt: Two-sector circular flow of income. Households and firms are joined by four numbered flows; flows 2, 3 and 4 are marked as the income, output and expenditure methods of measuring national income.
caption: A two-sector circular flow. Households supply factors of production to firms (1), and firms pay wages, rent, interest and profits back (2); firms supply goods and services to households (3), and households pay for them with expenditure (4). Flow (2) is what the income method measures, flow (3) the output method and flow (4) the expenditure method, so in theory all three give the same national income figure.
